name: kovaa-agent-skills
description: Independent agent skills for document research, product documentation governance, and reliable software delivery workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Document research, product, and delivery workflows
interface.longDescription: Use doc-research for bounded, traceable analysis across large document collections. Use dev-docs to guide product discovery, PRDs, roadmaps, decisions, maintenance, and documentation governance. Use dev-rules independently to execute engineering work with explicit scope, proportional validation, Git safety, pull-request readiness, and recoverable handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Research this question across the available documents and support the answer with traceable citations.
Help me shape a product idea into the smallest usable release path.
Implement this engineering task with explicit scope and proportional validation.
